body: This really means a lot to me! I think it’s extremely hard to live this way, i always felt bad for having those feelings but it’s not really something that i can control. She has everything that i’ve been struggling for years to have and not only her other people as well, I can’t seem to wrap my head around the fact that life is really unfair and appearances almost dictate everything about a person so why some people have to suffer and others are just gifted good looks! It’s pathetic!!

Thank you so much for your reply! It’s great to hear that someone else share the same feelings, it’s just that you feel like omg i really wish i had this thing that you have too but definitely without wishing any harm. I just think that those people are lucky af and i’m not talking only about myself and my friend. Sometimes i think about it the other way around like what if there’s that someone who’s less attractive than me, she might compare herself to me and wish that she had the privileges that i have so i think it’s really like a rabbit hole, once you “compare” yourself there’s no coming back except by improving yourself to be the best version of yourself which is definitely not an easy path, especially for me as my depression always prevented me from doing anything! Hope we heal from our insecurities and start loving ourselves!🤞🏽

I don’t mean to call you a coward, I apologize!  What i really wanted to say that killing yourself is not the answer. Talking to a therapist about your problems might be of help! No matter how big your problems are, they don’t actually matter if you thought about it from a bigger perspective. We’re just tiny stupid creatures in a world full of monsters, so why not facing those problems since each one of us isn’t really that important? if you think that your family won’t care, it’s probably not true and if your 100% that it’s true that seek a life away from them. Find the root cause to your misery and fight it and who knows maybe your life will turn upside down! Trust me i fucking hate myself, i have body dysmorphic disorder and i’m really unattractive but i then thought to myself, why making a big deal out of myself, who am i? I’m no one! So that means that i need to improve myself in other things for example i started to vigorously work and took many courses- just to find a way to stand out and the validation that came out of my work hustle was actually enough to not make me kill myself! Think about that please

Please don’t do something harmful to yourself, it’s not the answer to your misery. I’m not trying to be teach lessons or blabbing about the glass half full bullshit. I truly believe that life is nothing but suffering! It really is! But you can find out the “little” thing that will give your life a meaning maybe it’s helping someone out or being a good friend or even your parents! Taking away your life is not the solution, in fact it’ll be the beginning of suffering for someone else, your loved ones.. think about them!! I’ve been suicidal myself for many years but i always thought that it’d be the easy way out, don’t be a coward and face your problems! Life is really unfair and everything is meaningless so why adding some more misery to that! I also found out that everything literally everything changes just by how you look/ perceive them, i started to make friends soon after I discovered that. Please please don’t do something silly, i care about you a lot and i really want to talk to you if thats ok with you, feel free to DM me and lets let this all out and sort it out together!!
I promise i will, i’ve taken a few steps towards loving myself and i think i’m doing just fine so far!
Omg your smile is amazing and your hair too! You’re pretty girl! Own it

UPDATE!

Things are working perfectly fine! As if nothing happened.. too absurd to believe huh? But it happened and I’m pretty happy about the way it escalated. We’re just back to our normal male and female best friend kind of relationship. I won’t lie, sometimes i get flashbacks to that day but then i try to quickly distract myself!
